crossrefs.text: See to it that you make everything according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
These are a shadow of the things to come, but the body that casts it belongs to Christ.
Because of this oath, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
For the law is only a shadow of the good things to come, not the realities themselves. It can never, by the same sacrifices offered year after year, make perfect those who draw near to worship.
The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.

notes.title: The tabernacle as copy of the heavenly pattern

crossrefs.text: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
Then you will live in the land that I gave your forefathers; you will be My people, and I will be your God.

“But this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the LORD. I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
It is clear that you are a letter from Christ, the result of our ministry, written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God, not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.
And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them; I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh,
so that they may follow My statutes, keep My ordinances, and practice them. Then they will be My people, and I will be their God.
“This is the covenant I will make with them after those days, declares the Lord. I will put My laws in their hearts and inscribe them on their minds.”
Then He adds: “Their sins and lawless acts I will remember no more.”
